description: JVIZ Gantt Chart 3.0 introduces powerful new enhancements engineered to align your Power BI dashboards perfectly with your project management workflows. Whether you are a Project Manager, Event Scheduler, or Scrum Master, JVIZ Gantt Chart 3.0 delivers a slide-deck ready, aesthetically pleasing view of your portfolio that will position your reporting ahead of your peers and make your team shine. New Capabilities Included in this Version: - Microsoft Planner Synchronization: Specifically engineered to match your Microsoft Planner boards. The visual natively sorts by Microsoft Planner Outline and Sequence order, ensuring your Power BI timeline looks exactly as structured in your live project. - Deep 5-Level Task Hierarchy: Build out robust, multi-layered timelines up to 5 levels deep. Effortlessly roll up high-level metrics or drill down into granular subtasks. - Ragged Hierarchy Support: Natively supports asymmetric structures where branches of your project structure descend to different depths, eliminating blank rows or formatting errors. - Expanded Project Area Attributes: Display multiple new project attributes alongside your custom fields directly within the Gantt matrix area for enhanced data context. - Built-in Status Legend: Instantly communicate project health with a clean, built-in legend that automatically maps task bar colors to execution statuses. - Bar Icon Ranking…
